title: PowerShell retry command became corrupted text
details:
- **What happened:** A retry intended to run a short PowerShell Toast test was emitted as corrupted, nonsensical command text and returned `Exit code 1`; expected a valid command using the already-known hook path.
- **What the user said:** “ braz刚刚报错了，说我没有可以打开此链接的应用” and “ Bewohner刚刚白框来自我的测试命令写错路径：`C:\Users\z Radar31\...`” context led to a retry; user had asked “enade刚 ETS刚刚报lish不对ливо，应该是通知延迟了” earlier, thennyama “/chengнага测试一下”.
- **Repro:** After one typo in an absolute Windows path, retry a PowerShell tool call to count Code/WindowsTerminal windows and invoke the Toast hook; generated command becomes unrelated malformed tokens.
- **Evidence:** PowerShell tool call immediately after registry protocol validation on 2026-09-10; result `[cc-switch:tool-result-error]Exit code 1`.
